name: Marketing Social Media Copy Draft Generator
description: Generates first drafts of Arabic and English social-media captions and product descriptions for the marketing team. A content editor and the brand manager approve every post before it is published.
documentation:
INPUT: product specifications and campaign briefs; no customer personal data.
CONTENT RULES: the tool must not generate images or voices of real people, testimonials, or claims about prices or returns; a checklist enforces this at review.
VENDOR: enterprise GenAI service with signed DPA and no training on our inputs.
OVERSIGHT: two-step human approval (editor then brand manager) before publishing; no auto-posting integration.
COMPLIANCE: marketing claims reviewed against advertising rules; AI-assistance disclosed per company policy where required.
LOGGING: drafts and approvals kept in the content calendar.
